ref_text: وإذا فيه تعليمات للموقع مثل بوابة أو رقم شقة، أضفها عشان ما يتعطل الوصول.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_cs/wavs/najdi_cs_4_najdi_cs_01_clean_010.wav (id najdi_cs_00380, cut from set 4's najdi_cs_01_clean.wav; no najdi_cs clip is in najdi_mix_v3, so the shipped checkpoint never trained on this voice)
notes: The male voice of the synthetic najdi_cs customer-support sets, where the agent calls himself Rashed (set 4), Fahad (set 7) and Khaled (sets 2, 5): one synthesiser voice under several names (speaker similarity 0.89 across its 22 recordings). The omnivoice_najdi model only clones it. Picked from 29 candidate segments of 5-9 s: of the eight cloned with the shipped model this gave the closest clones (similarity 0.749, next 0.738) with the highest UTMOS (3.40).
